items.text: Hello fellow winemakers! 🍇
We needed a bit of time (and a lot of deep testing) after porting Hundred Days – Winemaking Simulator to Unity 6!
This upgrade was crucial to address important security concerns and to ensure we can continue supporting the game in the long run.
Over the past month we’ve stress-tested the build extensively, but as always, real-world usage is the ultimate test.
If you encounter any stability issues, crashes, or unexpected behavior, please let us know — your feedback is invaluable in helping us keep the experience smooth and enjoyable.
Thank you for your patience and continued support! ❤️
Happy winemaking! 🍷

items.text: Hello Fellow winemakers!
It's a long time we haven't updated the game, but we needed some time off to cure our vines and be sure to be ready for the harvest...
SPOILER: The Barbera harvest 2022 is going super!
To celebrate our come back updates we wanna start with a super important game changer... We are opening the Steam Workshop for Hundred Days - Winemaking Simulator!
Now you can share and play with custom grapes directly from Steam Workshop!
Once you subscribe to a custom made grape you will find it here, in the endless mode selection "WORKSHOP" tab:
If you want upload a custom made grape to the workshop instead, you need to make your grape in the Grape Lab free DLC and then upload it by clicking the following button:
I hope you like this is new feature, on top of that there is some other changes, here the full list:
ADDED WorkShop integration [Steam only]
ADDED “easy” seed ( courtesy of AnimeDev from Discord server)
FIX Major bug fix on save file problems
FIX it’s not possible to buy land before you receive the second letter in story mode
FIX Missing label fix
FIX Major and minor bug fix
We have also received a lot of request to help translate the game in other languages, we have open a Crowd Sourced localization project in Crowdin:
Reach out in case you are interested :)
As alway stay awesome

Hello fellows Winemakers!
WE HEARD YOU ːlunar2019grinningpigː in this patch we have reworked the wear/dirt/broken state of the tools and machinery.
Now the dirt and broken state don't occur randomly, instead the tool becomes dirty after 30% of wear and it break if you neglect the dirt state.
And for quality of life you will get automatically the cleaning card if a tool enter the dirty state, no more navigate through the building menu to search which tool become dirty!
The cleaning card will stay in the hand for 3 turns, the repair card stays forever.

Hello Winemakers community!

First of all we are really sorry for not sharing any update in the last 6 months ... we have been really busy with the development of the game, everyone of the team is doing fine, working remotely from their homes and we hope you and all your loved one are doing great too 💖
Hundred Days is finally feature complete 🥳 during the first few months of 2021 we will reveal the release date, keep following the game page and our social media channels for news 📰
In the last few weeks we have been working with the incredible team of Tumult Kollektiv to give the game the best atmosphere possible through amazing audio and high quality sounds effect.

We focused a lot on creating the most relaxed, peaceful and carefree experience even on the sound aspect of the game, we believe that the audio is really ASMR and sometimes we would love reality to have these extraordinary soft sounds.
But, because we always have fun while working, Tumult Kollektiv team created a funny and ironic preview video for all of you to enjoy, check out the video here below ⬇️
Backstage footage of the audio team grabbing SFX live in the vineyards last September:
Making a game about wine they said, it will be fun they said ...

If you are interested to connect with us and other people from Hundred Days community, we have created a Discord server where you can join this growing community and keep up to date with the development of the game.
Hello Winemakers!
First of all, we would like to thank you all for wishlisting Hundred Days! Your interest in our game and your fantastic feedbacks so far are absolutely mindblowing.

It’s been a while since we shared an update: we have been a little bit silent in the last few weeks after Spring Game Festival mainly due to Covid-19 pandemic worldwide situation but we have been really busy digging through all the survey entries.
We want to reassure you that the development is still moving forward, a little bit slower than usual, but still going strong.
A lot of good ideas came up by all of you playing the demo, in case you missed it, you can download it here: https://brokenarmsgames.itch.io/hundred-days

If you are interested to connect with us and other people from Hundred Days community, we have created a Discord server where you can join this growing community and keep up to date with the development of the game.
